beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:hushed, wonder]About twelve thousand years ago, someone carved a ^camel, life-size, high up a desert@noun ^cliff. [p:0.93][act:vivid, a little amazed]One panel sits thirty-nine metres up: as high as a twelve-storey ^building.

[d:calm][act:plain, orienting]We're on the southern edge of the Nefud, a great sea of sand in northern ^Arabia. [act:steady]In {2025|twenty twenty-five}, a team published sixty-two carved panels at three ^sites. [act:careful, respectful]The exact places are kept quiet, to protect the ^art.

[d:build][act:impressed, building]A hundred and seventy-six engravings in ^all. [p:0.93][act:vivid, a little amazed]A hundred and thirty of them are ^life-size: animals from one point seven to three metres long, as big as the real ^thing.

[d:build][go:3|0][act:counting, delighted]Most are ^camels: ninety of them. [act:ticking them off][tune:level]Then ibex, gazelles, wild ^donkeys. [act:delighted][tune:fall]And one wild ^aurochs, the giant ancestor of today's ^cattle.

[d:build][act:precise, building]At the foot of the cliffs, archaeologists dug into the ^ground. [act:precise][tune:level]They found hearths, stone ^points, and ^beads carried from more than three hundred kilometres ^away. [p:0.93][act:the reveal]That camp dates to about twelve thousand years ^ago, when seasonal lakes filled the hollows between the ^dunes.
[d:aside][act:context, wonder]That's around the time the great stone pillars of Göbekli ^Tepe were rising, far to the ^north.

[d:reveal][act:the crux, slower]But here's the ^catch: the carvings themselves aren't ^dated. [act:explaining, a simple picture]A campfire below a carving is like a ticket stub found under a ^mural: it tells you someone was there that day, not when the wall was ^painted. [act:fair, the challenger's case]One archaeologist notes the carvings could be as young as eight thousand ^years.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, even][tune:rise]Giant art from the end of the Ice ^Age? [act:the verdict, measured][tune:fall]^*Plausible*. [act:fair]The camp is ^dated. [act:fair, a small smile]The cliff is not, ^yet.

[d:tension][p:0.93][act:thoughtful, warm]In a land where water came and went, a giant camel could be seen from far ^away. [act:the last word, a small smile][tune:fall]Perhaps they were ^signposts: water, this ^way.
